page.notes: The brace diagram is transcribed as outline lines; the facing right page is cropped to fragments and only the fragments are legible. Several marginal words of the facing page are illegible and not transcribed. Greek in the text ("καθ' ἐξοχὴν πίσται") is a best reading of the scan, marked as uncertain: καθ' ἐξοχὴν πίστει.
